ns2:course.label: Piano Ensemble
ns2:course.description: Piano Ensemble comprises the study of the piano duet and piano duo literature, in addition to other works written for multiple pianos. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. May be repeated in separate semesters to a maximum of 8 undergraduate hours and 6 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
